title: Hugho and Holmes to Crew on HOKULE’A
version: The Outrigger, April 1976, p. 5; participant interview before the Tahiti voyage
lineage: Contemporaneous pre-voyage participant interview; it describes plans, not proof of their execution. The subsequent PVS account establishes the actual voyage.

passages.locator: p. 5, opening column and experimental voyage paragraph
passages.note: Describes an experimental project, a year under sail, 1975 launch and major modifications after a swamping near Kauaʻi.
